easy: The best starting level for learning; you win more often than in an even game
standard: About an even game at every table size
hard: Tougher than an even game; close to the app's rivals at two or three rivals
expert: About as strong as the app's rivals, or a little stronger at four or five rivals
method: Each cell is 360 games on fresh seeds (block 200000) not used to tune the rules. Lower means tougher rivals. In a perfectly even game the player would win 33% against two rivals, 25% against three, 20% against four and 17% against five.
strategy: **Strategy balance.** Chasing Domination cards is the strongest approach in testing, against both paper and app rivals: at Standard it wins 23–48% against paper rivals versus 8–23% for spreading out or chasing majorities. The gap narrows at Expert. If you want a harder game, avoid leaning on Domination cards, or move up a level.
stalls: With the Barren Earth step, no test game stalled: every game reached a normal end. If the action display fills before every rival has placed, Planning simply ends and the extra pawns wait for the next turn.
